name: Bleed Blood
source:
Main character goes on a date with his lover and gets killed by a werewolf who devours human souls. When protagonist's spirit is reincarnated, he is no longer human. He starts his war against youkai feeding on humans.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
